001package bank.model;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.math.RoundingMode;
005
006/**
007 * ============================================================================
008 *  CheckingAccount.java
009 *  Owner    : Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu)
010 *  Helped by: Jordon Tang         (jtang10@umbc.edu)
011 * ============================================================================
012 *
013 *  RULES FOR THIS ACCOUNT TYPE:
014 *      - Allows overdraft up to a specified limit.
015 *      - Withdrawals exceeding the overdraft limit are rejected.
016 *      - This account type does not earn interest.
017 * ============================================================================
018 */
019public class CheckingAccount extends Account {
020
021    /** The maximum allowed negative balance. Default is $100.00. */
022    private BigDecimal overdraftLimit = new BigDecimal("100.00");
023
024    /** No-argument constructor required for Gson deserialization. */
025    protected CheckingAccount() { }
026
027    /**
028     * Initializes a new CheckingAccount.
029     * 
030     * @param id The account identifier.
031     * @param initialBalance The starting balance.
032     * @param overdraftLimit The maximum allowed overdraft amount.
033     */
034    public CheckingAccount(String id, BigDecimal initialBalance, BigDecimal overdraftLimit) {
035        super("CHECKING", id, initialBalance);
036        this.overdraftLimit = overdraftLimit;
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * Subtracts an amount from the balance, enforcing the overdraft limit.
041     *
042     * @param amount The amount to withdraw.
043     * @throws IllegalStateException If the withdrawal would exceed the overdraft limit.
044     * @return The updated balance.
045     */
046    @Override
047    public BigDecimal debit(BigDecimal amount) {
048        BigDecimal projectedBalance = this.balance.subtract(amount);
049        
050        // Check if the projected balance would drop below the allowed overdraft limit.
051        // overdraftLimit is stored as a positive value (e.g., 100), so we compare against -overdraftLimit.
052        if (projectedBalance.compareTo(overdraftLimit.negate()) < 0) {
053            throw new IllegalStateException("Transaction rejected: Would exceed overdraft limit of $" + overdraftLimit);
054        }
055        
056        return super.debit(amount);
057    }
058
059    @Override
060    public BigDecimal getMonthlyInterestRate() {
061        return BigDecimal.ZERO;   // Checking earns nothing.
062    }
063
064    public BigDecimal getOverdraftLimit() {
065        return overdraftLimit;
066    }
067}
